name: GAIAXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Three-tone virtual-analog synth modelled on the discontinued Roland GAIA SH-01 (not affiliated with Roland): the editor's parameters over six full-screen pages, 21 oscillator variations (with KORG logue-sdk wave tables), SYNC/RING, the GAIA's effects chain and arpeggiator, two beams, a musical randomizer and 64 patches.
